name: instacart-ph
description: instaCart.PH — Full-stack production platform (React frontend + Express backend)

scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && npm ci && npx tsc
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
